channel.title: ISIL (Da’esh) and Al-Qaida Sanctions List (1267): List Updates
channel.description: Status of the ISIL (Da’esh) and Al-Qaida Sanctions List maintained by the Security Council Committee pursuant to resolutions 1267 (1999), 1989 (2011) and 2253 (2015). One item is added each time the list is updated.

item.title: Sanctions List updated on 20 November 2026: 245 individuals, 88 entities
item.description: The ISIL (Da’esh) and Al-Qaida Sanctions List now contains 245 individuals and 88 entities, and was last updated on 20 November 2026. It supersedes all previous versions. Under resolution 2734 (2024), the listed persons and entities are subject to an assets freeze, a travel ban and an arms embargo. Full list (XML): https://scsanctions.un.org/xml/en/al-qaida | List (HTML): https://scsanctions.un.org/en/?keywords=al-qaida | Narrative summaries of reasons for listing: https://main.un.org/securitycouncil/en/sanctions/1267/aq_sanctions_list/summaries
